description_html:
This stunning 38th floor apartment features interiors designed by John Pawson, defined by a restrained palette, and an understated signature minimalist aesthetic. With poured concrete flooring throughout, a bespoke kitchen with Silestone worktops, bespoke cabinetry with two workstations, One large bedroom, two bathrooms with Carrara marble tiles, some light fittings and furniture designed by Pawson are available by separate negotiation.

The apartment has been the subject of a complete renovation designed entirely by Pawson, UV film has been added to all windows, with remote controlled Silent Gliss blinds to remain. A free-standing timber volume inserted within the core of the cleared flo

Inserted room

The bespoke kitchen has a Bosch washing machine, tumble dryer, wine fridge, larder fridge, dishwasher and extensive fitted cabinets.

With a full width sliding door leading to a balcony with a spacious north-facing terrace, with a conjoining east-facing balcony that runs the length of the apartment, flooding it with morning sunlight.

Cromwell Tower benefits from 24 hour porterage and parking below the building, parking spaces and storage rooms are available by separate negotiation with the Corporation of London. There is a full size Waitrose supermarket on Whitecross Street.

Situated within the City of London, you are walking distance to Clerkenwell with its plethora of Bars and restaurants, five-star hotels and the many banks, law firms and businesses nearby.

Within walking distance to Barbican, Farringdon, Moorgate and Liverpool Street stations. (Elizabeth line, Circle, Hammersmith and City, Northern and Central lines) for easy access to the City with the West End , Home Counties, Canary Wharf and three of London's five airports.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 171
Service Charge: £12,491 (Yearly)
Annual Ground Rent: £0
Council Tax Band: G
